items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Mit dem Einspruch können Sie diesen Bescheid anfechten, und zwar binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (posting day) = 15.06.2026 (Monday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date stated, so the printed date is the posting day. Letter posted after 1 Jan 2025 → delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting: 15.06.2026 + 4 days = 19.06.2026 (Friday). For Finanzamt, if that 4th day were a Sat/Sun/holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO); 19.06.2026 is a Friday, no holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 19.06.2026. One-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO, counted per §188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe is not counted as day 1; the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 19.07.2026 (Sunday). Since the last day is a Sunday, per §108 Abs.3 AO / §193 BGB the period moves to the next working day: Monday 20.07.2026 (no NRW public holiday on that date).

warnings: The office address postcode (37002) appears to correspond to Lower Saxony rather than Nordrhein-Westfalen; NW holidays were used per the given instructions since the letter does not clearly indicate the relevant Land, but this made no difference to the computed due date.
